title: BUGFIX — Achiri persistent typing indicator (refresh every 4s)
rationale: Telegram 'typing' action expires in ~5s. Achiri uses qwen3:4b which takes 30-60s+ off-peak. After Sprint 1459 (60s timeout), users see typing for 5s then nothing for 55s — very poor UX. Fix: add setInterval that refreshes sendChatAction every 4s while waiting for handler.chat(), cleared in finally block. One surgical edit to agents/achiri/telegram-bot.ts around line 1011.

tasks.description: agents/achiri/telegram-bot.ts: wrap handler.chat() with a setInterval that calls sendChatAction('typing') every 4s. Clear in finally block. Ensures typing indicator stays visible for the full LLM response duration.
